about: The helper surface: every file an adopter may import or source from outside the plugin, and the names each one exports, plus every script an adopter may run as a command, and the argv each one accepts. A file, export or command not listed here is internal and may change in any release. Paths are relative to the plugin root.
versioning: The plugin's semver is the surface's version. Removing or renaming an entry point or a listed export, or changing an export's call shape incompatibly, is a major change and needs a migration note under migrations/. So is removing a listed command, removing or reordering its listed positionals, removing a listed flag or a listed positional value, or changing what a listed exit code means. So is adding a positional or flag a caller must now pass. Adding an entry point, an export, a command, a positional value, or a positional or flag a caller may omit is a minor change.

positionals.name: profile
positionals.meaning: which checker's envelope the two files hold

positionals.name: staged
positionals.meaning: path to the checker's --json envelope over this commit

positionals.name: baseline
positionals.meaning: path to the same checker's --json envelope over HEAD

exit.0: every fault in staged is inherited from baseline
exit.1: stdout lists the faults staged adds, one per line
exit.2: could not answer; the caller must refuse, not assume inherited

positionals.name: mode
positionals.meaning: shell-files: the shell files check:sh lints and the format gate formats, minus what .gitattributes marks linguist-vendored or linguist-generated (#1828)

flags.name: --tracked
flags.meaning: list every tracked shell file, one a line, read from the host root; without it, the shell files among the paths on stdin

exit.0: stdout lists the shell files, one per line
exit.1: git failed; stdout is empty and the caller must not read it as no shell files

positionals.name: timings
positionals.meaning: path to a JSON object mapping each test file the run timed, repo-relative or absolute, to its seconds

exit.0: always: stdout carries the run-cost report's lines, one fail-open line, or nothing

flags.name: --seed
flags.meaning: run Stryker once over every file HEAD holds on a declared sensitive path that the mutation hold would mutate, filling the hold's shared cache; judges nothing and commits nothing (#1912)

exit.1: nothing was seeded: no mutable declared file, a missing tool, a red initial run, a Stryker that did not finish, or a fault; stderr says which

positionals.name: path
positionals.meaning: the repo-relative document to register as a docs/doc-map-classes.json key

flags.name: --class
flags.value: one of the five §A class tokens

flags.name: --section
flags.value: the §A subsection the row renders under

flags.name: --reader
flags.value: agent, human or both; required on a .md or .html path, refused on any other

flags.name: --qualifier
flags.value: free text, stored as the key's classQualifier

flags.name: --consumes
flags.value: a JSON array of typed references

flags.name: --role
flags.value: the §A Role cell; alone, sets the role of a registered key

flags.name: --route
flags.value: the §A Update route cell; alone, sets the route of a registered key

flags.name: --new-section
flags.meaning: admit a --section no existing key uses

flags.name: --no-claim
flags.meaning: skip the arbiter claim on the sidecar key

flags.name: --claim-cmd
flags.value: a command run as `<cmd> <subject>` in place of the arbiter's claim

flags.name: --release-cmd
flags.value: a command run as `<cmd> <subject>` in place of the arbiter's release

flags.name: --data-file
flags.value: the sidecar read and written, in place of the host repo's docs/doc-map-classes.json

exit.0: registered the key, or set its role or route
exit.1: refused: a held claim, or a registration the sidecar or its validation forbids
exit.2: no path, a value flag with no value, or an unreadable sidecar

flags.name: --changed
flags.meaning: select the tests from the uncommitted diff

exit.1: a test failed, or the run stalled or was killed
